tvShow.name: R.J. Decker
tvShow.overview: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Ex-con photographer R.J. Decker becomes a private investigator in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

episodes.name: Twenty Pounds of Clem in a Ten-Pound Bag
episodes.overview: Wish enlists R.J.'s help on a bizarre case when his late cellmate's son is wrongly accused of murder.

episodes.name: The Needle and the Damage Done
episodes.overview: R.J. is recruited by Emi to investigate the disappearance of a wealthy rehab tycoon's son; Mel and Catherine discover they have different views on parenting and finances.

episodes.name: In Vanity Veritas
episodes.overview: R.J. finds himself at the center of a suburban housewife murder mystery; Catherine worries that R.J. is getting too close to Emi.

episodes.name: Burn Notice
episodes.overview: R.J. unravels the truth about a Little League coach whose family is being mysteriously targeted; R.J.'s parole officer worries that he is pushing the boundaries of his conditional release.

episodes.name: Brenner's Back
episodes.overview: R.J. helps a young woman uncover the truth behind her boyfriend's sudden death; a dangerous figure from R.J.'s past resurfaces, bent on revenge.

episodes.name: You've Got Bale
episodes.overview: R.J. takes on a strange case following a grocery store robbery gone wrong; Emi's loyalty is tested when her father's misdeeds come to light.

episodes.name: Burn the Boats
episodes.overview: R.J. struggles with a difficult decision; Emi must contend with her family's secrets.

episodes.name: Even Walls Fall Down
episodes.overview: After R.J. learns the truth about what happened on the fateful day Lucas stole his camera, he enlists his inner circle to help him take down Victor Ochoa.

reviews.author: Damian @ TalkTeaV
reviews.content: R.J. Decker has a great crew and the perfect Florida setting for a detective show. It reminds me of a mix between Magnum P.I., with that sunny private eye vibe, and Burn Notice, where a guy who lost his job helps out regular people while dealing with local crooks. If the leads keep hitting it off like they are now, we might even get some of that Moonlighting energy in the next few episodes.
